purpose: Find small incremental effects and test fixed-capital complementarity without optimizing basket weights on observed results.
history_status: Previously inspected history. Every result is exploratory, not a new independent holdout.

combination.design: segregated fixed-initial-capital sleeves; no rebalancing, cross-margin, netting or capital sharing
combination.period_note: Mix measures first daily close to last daily close, not January 1 open. Do not compare this slice directly with full-window standalone PnL.
combination.missing_branch_policy: Do not manufacture NAV from event-return averages; report unavailable three-branch mix separately.
combination.missing_dates_policy: Reject. Never fill missing dates or align by silently dropping rows.
combination.unverified_funding_policy: Allow explicitly declared complete proxy-account curves for diagnostic mixing only. Never label the mix financially verified.
combination.causal_interpretation: Low return correlation is possible complementarity, not proof of alpha. Mixing may reduce risk without increasing returns. Small losing branches are not rescued merely by addition.
